name: trellis
description: Kanban boards and a vault for AI agents on a shared Trellis server. The plugin registers the server over MCP; hooks inject the board brief, recall entries for each prompt and remind about claimed cards. The skills teach the MCP tools.

plugins.name: trellis
plugins.description: Work with Trellis boards, cards and vault entries through the Trellis MCP server.

plugins.name: sdd
plugins.description: Spec-first work that stands on tests: one spec per story, cases approved before code, and hooks that check claims against git and the test suite. Uses Trellis when installed; works without it.
